interpretation: Direct scanout remains reliable: the capture has no copy fallback and no CTL timeout.
The active gap is mixed. Swap production arrives about 11.5 ms after the prior latch on average, while post-arrival work contributes another 5.7 ms.

About 88 percent of active gaps encounter an unfinished GPU fence. The measured fence interval averages about 7.6 ms, so real GPU work contributes materially; a polling-wakeup change alone cannot remove it.
The roughly 9.8 ms acknowledgement interval includes waiting for a physical 60 Hz refresh. It is not evidence that the display driver can safely retire the IOSurface early.
limits: This is one 64-second interactive desktop workload, not a matched trace from the reference port.
Two-second counter windows can begin or end during a fence wait, so aggregate fence and post-arrival means need not close exactly.
The uploaded image called the existing at-least-250-ms counter fence_timeout in its log. The source and analyzer now use the accurate name fence_slow250; behavior is unchanged.
